LESSON: PARTS OF A PLANT

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / PP1
Subject: General
Strand: My Neighbourhood
Topic 4.3: Parts of a plant
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 10

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Parts of a plant, part of My Neighbourhood in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / PP1 General.

Key inquiry question: Why do we have Plants? 2. How do we identify parts of a plant?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Parts of a plant together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Values:
● Love: sharing –as learner share learning materials.

● Responsibility: accountability – as learner displays mounted different parts of a plant on the chart.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Environmental education – environmental awareness as the learner walk around the environment to collect plants and identify parts of plant.

Link to other learning area

Language Activities: The learner is able to relate to the skills acquired in Language Activities as they sign poems about parts of plant.

Suggested Learning Resources:

Charts, picture cards , flash cards, drawn pictures, glue, crayons, realia, photos, coloured pencils, relevant digital devices, signed audio
